summary:
Agrisense AI – Smart Crop Rotation & Soil Health Decision Platform
Agrisense AI is an intelligent agriculture platform designed to help farmers make smarter and more sustainable farming decisions using Artificial Intelligence and NASA Earth observation data.
We are developing a farmer-friendly web application with the following features:
1. Smart Dashboard: Displays farm information, environmental conditions, and agricultural insights.
2.Soil Health Analysis: Helps farmers understand soil conditions, fertility, pH, and nutrient status.
3.Crop Explorer: Provides suitable crop recommendations based on soil, climate, and environmental conditions.
4.Crop Rotation Planner: Suggests sustainable crop rotation plans to improve soil health and productivity.
5. NASA Data Integration: Uses NASA POWER, GPM, and SMAP datasets for temperature, rainfall, and soil moisture analysis.
6.AI Plant Disease Detection: Identifies potential plant diseases from uploaded images and provides treatment suggestions.
7.AI Agriculture Chatbot: Offers friendly conversations and personalized agricultural guidance.
8.Farm Management: Allows farmers to manage farm details and access location-based information.
Technology Stack: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Python FastAPI, MongoDB Atlas, TensorFlow, Gemini AI, and NASA Earth observation APIs.
Our Vision: To empower farmers with accessible AI-powered insights, improve soil health, support sustainable farming, and make agriculture smarter.
details:
AgriSense AI is an AI-powered agriculture platform that helps farmers make smarter and more sustainable farming decisions using NASA satellite data.

It includes a Smart Dashboard, Soil Health Analysis, Crop Explorer, Crop Rotation Planner, AI Plant Disease Detection, and an Agriculture Chatbot. It uses NASA POWER, GPM, and SMAP data to analyze temperature, rainfall, and soil moisture and provide location-based agricultural insights.

The platform helps farmers select suitable crops, improve soil health, manage water resources, identify plant diseases, and adopt sustainable farming practices.

We developed AgriSense AI using React.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Python, FastAPI, MongoDB Atlas, TensorFlow, Gemini AI, and NASA APIs.

Our goal is to combine space technology and artificial intelligence to make farming smarter, easier, and more sustainable.
